title: gameFT-6551
tagline: GameFT-6551 - Transforming gaming with ERC-6551 NFTs. Play, collect, and unlock unique features. Join the future of GameFi now!
description:
-> Web 2 gaming features like chat, communication, challenge invites, we are bringing them on onchain seamless and bundleform. 
-> Currently games are mostly based on play to one architecture because of P2E architecture actual fun elements of games are lacking. Only few web 3 games have proved to be actually sustainable. Once tokonomics of any P2E game is disturbed number of daily active users start dealing expondantally and thus most of the web 3 games fails. This is main reason why we are not able to see many long term web 3 games. We are solving this problems by figuring out balanced, propotioned P2E elements and the fun and playable elements.
-> To maintain the fun elements of games we are trying to keep the user experience simililar to web 3 traditional games and to the isssues with the P2E architecture we are going to use combination of old and new blockchain technologies like TBA[ERC - 6551] Burnable NFT's , AA [ERC - 4337].Etc.
-> AA 4337 and embedded wallet [ERC - 4337] allows user to easy onboarding.
-> By laveraging the power of token bounding NFT's we are able to upgrade a normal static ERC 721 gaming NFT's into a more meaningful utility token that will most likely replace web 2 gaming accounts.
